paragraphs: I'm applying for the Finance & Strategy Analyst role. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli in New York, and before school I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. Stripe's F&S team stewards where the company invests, and measuring whether those investments pay off is the part of finance I enjoy most.

At Lenovo I built forecasts and scenario models to evaluate capital allocation, which improved capital efficiency by 15%, and I ran variance and sensitivity analyses on budget reallocation options. At JPMorgan I worked on budget allocation across marketing channels, built models to evaluate $10M in deployment options and quantify ROI, and benchmarked past allocations against peers to find 30% efficiency gains.

Owning models for a business team, defining the metrics that show how it's performing and running the budget and forecast routine is the work I want to do. I'm comfortable with ambiguity and like building a model from scratch. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
